title: Time-optimal elevator control with higher-order state constraints: analysis and computation of boundary contacts
summary: In this paper, we consider the classical time-optimal elevator problem in the presence of higher-order state constraints. The main contribution is a constructive indirect solution framework based on a Pontryagin Maximum Principle specifically formulated for higher-order constrained systems. First, we derive specialized optimality conditions and analyze the resulting structure of extremal trajectories.
